blocks.text: AI can make you a study plan, a quiz and flashcards – from your own notes!
Important: Claude is for adults (18+). So practise the Claude lessons together with a parent, who uses their own account.
Important: you may use ChatGPT from age 13 and only with a parent's permission. If you're younger, practise together with a parent.
Important: you need a parent's permission for Gemini. Younger children can use it only through a parent's Family Link account, where available.

items: Type or paste your notes from your notebook (or describe them briefly).
Ask the AI for a short summary of the most important points.
Ask for a quiz – one question at a time.
Whatever you get wrong, go over again tomorrow.

blocks.text: These are my notes about volcanoes: [paste notes]. Make me 8 quiz questions, one at a time, and tell me if my answer is right.
I have a geography test on Friday. Today is Monday and I can study 30 minutes a day. Make me a study plan by day.
A little studying every day is better than a lot the night before the test.
Ask the AI to make "flashcards": a question on one side, the answer on the other. Write them on paper and practise with a friend.
